purpose.en: A public, shareable fine-edit style floor for talking-head videos when the creator has not supplied a preferred style.
purpose.zh-CN: 当创作者没有提供偏好风格时，为口播视频提供可公开复用的精剪风格下限。

selectionPolicy.whenNoUserStyle: Review the active curated styles, compare at least two plausible candidates, select the strongest content fit, and adapt it to the current transcript instead of asking the creator to invent a visual direction.
selectionPolicy.showMultipleDirectionsWhen: Two or more candidates remain materially close after content, evidence, platform, presenter, and attention-cost analysis.
selectionPolicy.singleRecommendationAllowedWhen: One candidate is clearly stronger and its 6-12 second audiovisual sample demonstrates the complete proposed treatment.
selectionPolicy.dynamicAdaptationAllowedWhen: No active style is a strong enough fit, or the content needs a new or hybrid visual system. At least two plausible active candidates are still recorded as references and rejected or selectively borrowed with concrete reasons.

referencePolicy.role: Open-ended reference and preference library, not a closed asset whitelist.
referencePolicy.markedStyleMeaning: A style may be retained because it was liked, used, approved, or deliberately curated. That signal affects retrieval and confidence but never overrides content fit.
referencePolicy.reuseBoundary: Reuse the generic design grammar and documented public preview assets. Do not copy private or uncleared source media, exact diagrams, text, identity art, or project geometry.
referencePolicy.outsideLibraryRule: When the library has no strong fit, design a new coherent audiovisual system and author, generate, capture, or source the required assets under the normal rights, cost, evidence, privacy, and approval gates.
referencePolicy.hybridRule: Borrow only compatible roles from existing entries and state what remains new. Do not combine styles merely to display variety.

sharedQualityFloor.mobileRule: Reveal dense information sequentially; never shrink a poster-sized composition into one unreadable phone frame.
sharedQualityFloor.motionRule: Every entrance, hold, state change, and exit is driven by the canonical timeline and a spoken or semantic cue.
sharedQualityFloor.audioRule: BGM and SFX are auditioned as part of the style sample; dialogue remains dominant and off is a reasoned option.

summary.en: Warm paper, hand-drawn connectors, compact semantic icons, and sequentially assembled process or relationship maps.
summary.zh-CN: 用暖白纸张、手绘连接线、语义小图标和逐步搭建的流程或关系地图解释抽象知识。

strongSignals: The narration contains a main path plus supporting modules.
Several abstract ideas become clearer when spatially grouped.
The audience needs orientation more than photographic inspection.
avoidWhen: The viewer must inspect an exact product state or source document.
The beat is primarily emotional, cinematic, or photorealistic.
The claim is a single low-density punchline.
Precise legal, financial, medical, or safety evidence must remain verbatim.

visualContract.colorBalance: Warm white dominates; green carries the main path; yellow, coral, blue, and orange mark distinct semantic roles rather than decorating every object.
visualContract.typography: Readable hand-lettered display plus compact handwritten or rounded body text; short phrases only inside video cards.
visualContract.iconography: Simple near-black outline icons with one or two flat fills; icons must name a semantic role such as document, checklist, terminal, shield, folder, person, robot, monitor, or arrow.
visualContract.microDecoration: Sparse stars, hearts, sparks, curved arrows, dots, and wavy underlines.

brollGrammar.buildRule: Show one module or relationship per spoken beat. The map may accumulate only after each element is earned by the narration.
brollGrammar.evidenceBoundary: Use real screenshots, recordings, documents, or source quotes for proof. The hand-drawn layer explains and orients; it never impersonates evidence.

motionGrammar.character: Light, tactile, friendly, and restrained; no continuous wobble or exaggerated elastic motion.

soundGrammar.rule: Use only when the sound clarifies a semantic action; do not sonify every icon.

provenance.note: The public recipe is a new renderer-neutral contract distilled from a supplied style reference. No source image, text, diagram, icon set, or third-party font is included.

styles.validationLevel: derived-from-approved-workflow-patterns; exact project treatment remains sample-gated

summary.en: A warm notebook system for chapters, experiments, lessons, progress, and creator-led journeys.
summary.zh-CN: 用手账纸张、路径、标签和便签呈现章节、实验、复盘、成长与创作者旅程。

strongSignals: The narration has a real beginning, middle, and changed ending.
Progress, attempts, or lessons matter more than a static taxonomy.
The speaker's continuity adds trust or warmth.
avoidWhen: The video is a hard investigative proof piece.
The viewer must compare several dense live interfaces at once.
The topic requires a clinical or deliberately cold tone.

visualContract.typography: Friendly handwritten headings paired with a highly readable body face.
visualContract.identityBoundary: Use neutral pens, tabs, stamps, and paper shapes. Creator characters, logos, signature art, and private markers are optional private adapters and are not part of this public style.

brollGrammar.buildRule: Use chapters only when they navigate real content. A path, tab, or stamp appears when the story reaches that stage, not as a permanent decorative overlay.
brollGrammar.evidenceBoundary: Evidence remains readable and uncropped inside the paper treatment; texture may frame it but may not lower credibility or hide source state.

motionGrammar.character: Warm and deliberate, with longer holds than the hand-drawn knowledge map.
motionGrammar.timing: Chapter changes follow semantic boundaries; small notes follow sentence cues.

soundGrammar.rule: Prefer one recognizable material cue per meaningful change, not a constant scrapbook sound bed.

provenance.note: Private character art, signature markers, project copy, and exact historical geometry are excluded.

summary.en: A high-contrast editorial system that makes real screenshots, recordings, claims, and numerical proof the visual center.
summary.zh-CN: 以高对比编辑设计承托真实截图、录屏、观点和数字证据，让证据成为画面中心。

strongSignals: The video contains source-backed screens or documents.
The central promise depends on credibility and exact state.
The story benefits from decisive contrast and a modern technical tone.
avoidWhen: The story is intimate, reflective, or intentionally soft.
There is no credible evidence asset and illustration would overstate certainty.
The platform crop cannot preserve the required proof region.

visualContract.colorBalance: Neutral evidence dominates. Yellow or another chosen accent organizes the frame; cobalt, coral, and green appear only for declared semantic roles.
visualContract.typography: Large editorial headlines, compact labels, and one dominant number or phrase per beat.

brollGrammar.buildRule: Establish the complete evidence state, then push, pan, or cut to one exact semantic ROI. Use large copy only after the source has earned the claim.
brollGrammar.evidenceBoundary: Never redraw an exact UI value as decoration, guess a crop, or cover a relevant adjacent state.

motionGrammar.character: Direct, controlled, and high-contrast; avoid playful bounce on serious proof.
motionGrammar.timing: Claim, proof, and callout remain token-accurate with no early state reveal.

soundGrammar.rule: Use sparse semantic cues; dense explainers may remain voice-only.

provenance.note: No creator footage, private palette lock, interface capture, or approved project geometry is included.

styles.validationLevel: public-curated-composition-contract; exact project treatment remains sample-gated

summary.en: Bold flat color blocks, geometric icons, and modular cards for comparisons, lists, tool families, and fast conceptual sorting.
summary.zh-CN: 用鲜明平涂色块、几何图标和模块卡片呈现对比、清单、工具分类与快速概念整理。

strongSignals: The narration contains peer items with clear category roles.
Fast recognition matters more than a continuous spatial map.
A bright, energetic tone fits the subject and presenter.
avoidWhen: The content has one continuous journey rather than peer modules.
The evidence itself is visually dense and already colorful.
The tone requires restraint, grief, seriousness, or photographic realism.

visualContract.colorBalance: Assign one stable color to one semantic family. Do not recolor the same category between cards.
visualContract.typography: Bold compact headings, short labels, and restrained body copy with high contrast.
visualContract.iconography: Geometric and symbolic rather than illustrative; all icons share stroke, corner, and fill logic.

brollGrammar.buildRule: Introduce one category, item, or comparison axis at a time; keep stable card geometry while content changes.
brollGrammar.evidenceBoundary: When a card refers to a real product or result, insert the real cleared asset or label the card as explanation rather than proof.

motionGrammar.character: Energetic but organized; no simultaneous entrance of every card.
motionGrammar.timing: Each module enters on its spoken label and holds long enough for phone-scale reading.

soundGrammar.rule: Keep a small repeated cue vocabulary and reserve stronger hits for the selected or winning item.

provenance.note: The recipe defines reusable design decisions and contains no third-party visual asset.
